headline: Customers could wait too long for disputed money
what_happens: From 4 Jan 2027, any card or ACH dispute not provisionally credited within 5 business days breaks the rule. Today the policy allows 10 and the procedure credits on day 7.
who_is_affected: Consumers disputing debit card and ACH transactions (about 310 disputes a month)
exam_note: Error resolution timing is a common examination focus for Regulation E.

illustrative_exposure.label: Illustrative only (synthetic)
illustrative_exposure.text: Customer remediation for late credits and a likely supervisory finding.

next: Update policy 4.2 and procedure step 4, then confirm vendor timings.

headline: The tracker that proves it is quiet
what_happens: The policy covers new-account and point-of-sale timing, but CTL-134 has produced no evidence for 43 days, so it cannot be shown to work.
who_is_affected: Consumers with new accounts or point-of-sale disputes
exam_note: Examiners ask for proof the control ran, not only the policy.

illustrative_exposure.label: Illustrative only (synthetic)
illustrative_exposure.text: Unproven control; finding risk if evidence stays missing.

next: Get CTL-134 evidence for the last six weeks.

headline: Privileged users could be phished
what_happens: No control requires phishing-resistant MFA for privileged access. Three vendors also hold privileged access.
exam_note: Information security programs are reviewed in every safety and soundness exam.

illustrative_exposure.label: Illustrative only (synthetic)
illustrative_exposure.text: Elevated breach risk; likely matter requiring attention if not fixed by 1 Dec.

next: Approve CTL-153 and the policy change.

headline: Branch fallback screen can release wires with one approver
what_happens: CTL-118 enforces two approvers in the wire platform, but the branch fallback screen bypasses it.
who_is_affected: Outbound wires above $100,000 released from branches (about 12 a month)
exam_note: Accepted by the CCO with a fix date.

illustrative_exposure.label: Illustrative only (synthetic)
illustrative_exposure.text: Fraud and error exposure on a small number of wires until the fix.

accepted.why: Vendor fix scheduled; branches told to route wires through the platform.

next: Confirm the vendor fix date or renew the gap.

headline: Revised estimates could go out late
what_happens: Policy and rule say 3 business days; the procedure says 5.
who_is_affected: Mortgage applicants with a changed circumstance (about 40 a month)
exam_note: TRID timing is routinely tested in consumer compliance exams.

illustrative_exposure.label: Illustrative only (synthetic)
illustrative_exposure.text: Possible tolerance cures and file-level findings.
